name: Regular Planning Commission Meeting - Adjourned
agenda_text:
NOTICE OF ADJOURNMENT

The April 21, 2020 regular meeting of the Planning Commission of the City of Artesia
has been adjourned, due to lack of quorum, to 6:30 p.m. on May 19, 2020, at the Albert
O. Little Community Center 18750 Clarkdale Ave., Artesia, California 90701.

__April 5, 2020__________  ____________________________________
Date  Fiona Graham, Interim Planning Manager
